title: The Box of Things That Nobody Claimed
title_ja: 誰も引き取りに来なかった忘れ物
fact_notes: 人物・施設・活動・結果は架空の事例。実在の統計や研究結果ではない。個別の法律・工学手順の説明を目的としない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり、実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: At the end of every school term, a group of student volunteers helped organize the unclaimed items in the lost property room.
sentences.ja: 各学期の終わりに、生徒ボランティアのグループは忘れ物保管室の引き取り手のない品を整理した。

sentences.en: They found umbrellas, water bottles, notebooks, and several bags that had remained on the shelves for many weeks.
sentences.ja: 傘、水筒、ノート、何週間も棚に残っていたバッグなどを見つけた。

sentences.en: One volunteer suggested selling some of the useful objects at a school event and donating the money to a local charity.
sentences.ja: あるボランティアは役立つ品の一部を学校行事で売り、収益を地元の慈善団体に寄付することを提案した。

sentences.en: The others liked the charitable intention, but they were uncertain whether the group had permission to dispose of property belonging to other people.
sentences.ja: ほかの生徒は慈善目的には賛成したが、他人の所有物を処分する許可があるか確信できなかった。

sentences.en: Their teacher explained that an object being unclaimed did not necessarily mean that its owner had intentionally abandoned it.
sentences.ja: 教師は品物に引き取り手がないことが必ずしも所有者が意図的に放棄したことを意味しないと説明した。

sentences.en: A student might not know where the lost property room was located, or might have been absent when notices were distributed.
sentences.ja: 忘れ物保管室の場所を知らなかったり、案内が配られたときに欠席していたりする場合もある。

sentences.en: The volunteers therefore decided to consult the school office and examine the existing procedures before making any arrangements for a sale.
sentences.ja: そこでボランティアは販売の手配前に学校事務室に相談し、既存の手続きを確認することにした。

sentences.en: The office agreed to coordinate a final reminder in accordance with the school's established rules for handling lost property.
sentences.ja: 事務室は学校の忘れ物取扱規則に従って最後の案内を調整することに同意した。

sentences.en: The students classified the objects by type and prepared a general description of each category without publishing personal information from the items.
sentences.ja: 生徒は品を種類別に分類し、品物にある個人情報を公開せず各分類の概要を作成した。

sentences.en: They also arranged several opportunities for students to visit the room and identify objects that might belong to them.
sentences.ja: 生徒が保管室に来て自分の物かもしれない品を確認できる機会も数回設けた。

sentences.en: People claiming an object were asked by the responsible staff to describe distinguishing features rather than simply select anything they wanted.
sentences.ja: 引き取る人は好きな物を選ぶのでなく、担当職員から特徴を説明するよう求められた。

sentences.en: Several objects were eventually returned, including a bag containing a notebook that its owner had been unable to replace.
sentences.ja: 最終的に数点が返却され、所有者が買い直せなかったノートの入ったバッグも含まれていた。

sentences.en: For the items that remained, the school office determined which could be handled under its approved disposal procedure.
sentences.ja: 残った物について学校事務室は承認済みの処分手続きで扱えるものを判断した。

sentences.en: The volunteers did not sell anything until the responsible staff confirmed that the relevant procedure had been completed.
sentences.ja: 担当職員が該当手続きの完了を確認するまでボランティアは何も販売しなかった。

sentences.en: They then helped organize a small event involving only objects that the school had authorized for that purpose.
sentences.ja: その後、学校が目的に沿って許可した物だけを扱う小規模な行事の準備を手伝った。

sentences.en: The group published a summary of the money raised and its intended use so that others could understand how the project had been managed.
sentences.ja: 活動の運営をほかの人も理解できるよう、集まった金額と使途の概要を公表した。

sentences.en: The experience taught the volunteers that a generous goal does not automatically justify every method chosen to achieve it.
sentences.ja: 体験から、善意の目標が達成のために選んだあらゆる方法を自動的に正当化するわけではないと学んだ。

sentences.en: Respecting the interests of people who are not present can be especially important when decisions are made about their belongings.
sentences.ja: 持ち物について決める際には、その場にいない人の利益を尊重することが特に重要になり得る。

sentences.en: Ethical action sometimes requires postponing an attractive plan until questions about responsibility and permission have been addressed.
sentences.ja: 倫理的な行動には、責任と許可の問題が解決するまで魅力的な計画を延期することが必要な場合がある。

sentences.en: For the students, the value of helping others included not only the final donation but also the fairness of the process leading to it.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちにとって他者支援の価値には最終的な寄付だけでなくそこに至る過程の公平さも含まれた。

options: New textbooks ordered for every class.

Unclaimed items in the lost property room.

Giving every object to the first student who arrived.
Throwing away every item immediately.
Keeping the objects for personal use.

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher question treating unclaimed items as abandoned?
options: The school had already purchased every object.
Every owner had explicitly rejected the items.
All objects had been brought as charity donations.
Owners might not know about the room or the notices.
questions.explanation_ja: 所有者が場所や案内を知らない可能性がある。

questions.prompt: What did the volunteers decide to do before arranging a sale?
options: Ask customers to set prices for every item.
Consult the school office and check the procedures.
Publish the names found in all notebooks.
Remove the existing school rules.
questions.explanation_ja: 事務室への相談と手続きの確認。

questions.prompt: What information did they avoid publishing?
options: Personal information from the objects.
General descriptions of categories.
Visit opportunities.
The fact that a lost property room existed.
questions.explanation_ja: 個人情報は公開しなかった。

questions.prompt: Why were claimants asked to describe distinguishing features?
options: To allow them to choose any item for free.
To encourage them to pay higher prices.
To help staff establish whether the objects belonged to them.
To prevent owners from recognizing their own property.
questions.explanation_ja: 持ち主の確認に役立つ。

questions.prompt: When were the volunteers allowed to sell objects?
options: Before the final reminder was sent.
After staff confirmed that the relevant procedure was complete.
Whenever a volunteer liked a particular item.
Immediately after the objects were first found.

questions.prompt: What did the group publish about the event?
options: Every original owner's private information.
A list of students who had lost items.
A promise to sell all future lost property without review.
A summary of the money raised and its intended use.
questions.explanation_ja: 収益と使途の概要を公表した。

questions.prompt: What does justify mean in context?
options: Make something occur sooner.
Give an object a new price.
Show that something is reasonable or right.
Describe an item without identifying it.
questions.explanation_ja: 正当化するという意味。

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the passage's lesson?
options: A charitable goal should be pursued through a process that respects others' rights and interests.
A good purpose makes permission unnecessary.
Unclaimed objects always belong to whoever finds them.
Ethical decisions should consider results alone.
questions.explanation_ja: 善意だけでなく他人の利益や手続きの公平さを尊重する。
